name: The Interdimensional Hotel Catastrophe
description: A reality-bending comedy adventure across dimensions. You're Rex Doorman, a bellhop who must save the multiverse when someone steals the Reality Anchor. Navigate 40 bizarre rooms, meet 36 eccentric characters, solve weird puzzles, and restore reality before your shift ends!

victory_conditions.description: Restore the Reality Anchor to save the hotel and fix reality

metadata.author: The Quest Weavers
features: 78 items with creative uses and combinations
Multiple quest lines and branching dialogues
Combat encounters with dragons and void beings
Easter eggs referencing classic adventure games
Heavy dose of humor and absurdity
